note: (R) Which captured car body each vehicle item shows in the garage, a race and a derby. `definitions` are ReadVehicleDefinition blobs (`009d7b50`: u32 name length, name, f32, the attribute block) from the retail race and derby captures; the eight dm_* ones are byte-identical to derby_entry.json, kt_kart08 to kart_entry.json's entry vehicle, and the five speedster/zipster karts were the captured race's AI karts (every asset in the 2014 packs). The item-to-look rows are a reconstruction by name: live's formula for turning a vehicle id and parts into a definition never reached the client. A vehicle with no row keeps the race's or derby's default car.
